In addition, Leo planned regular meetings with Noor and discussed the AI project with her at Caroline's Café. He reminded Andy of their AI project meeting with Noor and Samantha the next day at Caroline's Café. They discussed an impromptu duet with birds, robotics ideas, and shared plans to work on these at Caroline's Café.

Later, Leo had a conversation with Andy at the gym, where they agreed to meet at the park the next day at 2 PM to discuss their AI project and share Leo's interesting sketches. They proposed a quiet bench near the lake as an ideal spot for their creative conversation.

On the same day, Leo had a conversation with Mei at the park where they discussed a new piece inspired by the birds' songs and planned to perform it together at Caroline's Café the next day. They agreed to make it a double date with Noor. Their updated schedules now include these meetings in addition to the previously scheduled meeting with Samantha at the train station on January 8, 2026, at 7 AM, and the meeting with Andy at Caroline's Café on January 9, 2026, at 1 PM.
